Usage: specify integration upgrade [OPTIONS] [key]                             
                                                                                
 Upgrade an integration by reinstalling with diff-aware file handling.          
                                                                                
 Compares manifest hashes to detect locally modified files and                  
 blocks the upgrade unless --force is used.                                     
                                                                                
╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│   key      <str>  Integration key to upgrade (default: current integration)  │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --force                             Force upgrade even if files are modified │
│ --script                     <str>  Script type: sh, ps, or py (default:     │
│                                     from init-options.json or platform       │
│                                     default)                                 │
│ --integration-options        <str>  Options for the integration              │
│ --help                              Show this message and exit.              │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
